_comment: Run from packages/sdk (pnpm --filter exec). inPlace:true because packages/sdk is NOT relocatable: vitest.setup.ts imports ../../tools/preflight-native-bindings.mjs, which escapes the package to the monorepo root, so any sandbox copy breaks before a single test is collected. related:false because tests live in a mirror tree (tests/**) and vitest --related cannot map a source file back to them.
